= "Prove RootHandle or inherited parent-borrow origin before any wait/root copy; raw movable SCMOBJ ingress without prior root authority is rejected. = "Canonical noncollecting tryReserve on complete rooted input view is final allocator-layout effect before a no-GC/no-reentry shuffle/repair interval; reserve includes all rest pairs from first CONS plus fallback packet, frame/argument stack and metadata budgets; unused grant cancellation and construction entry share one arbitration; no intervening allocating helper/POLL or legacy heap_limit cursor migration while lease live; initialize objects then advance actual prefix hp, close lease at complete FrameReady before GC"

= "Release-publish complete rooted call view before reservation; same atomic registry serializes grant/cancel/enter and GC/layout close; allocation owner and disjoint actual intervals validated before canonical grant, acquire consumer validates server status/epoch/layout/serial/input plus current cursor; last constructor store/initialized prefix and full frame precede lease close and GC admission; collector relocation precedes acquire root reload and new grant; old replies cannot mutate claimed writer permit, stale refund cannot retire new grant; actual C pointer arithmetic/atomics/lock order and helper effects remain open"

= "slot arguments evaluated and saved -> register operands evaluated/spilled -> reload -> adjust-slots -> seal-bb -> make-jump -> C checks/adjust/jump"

= "Last initialized heap store, hp prefix, complete FrameSpec/R0 and no-native-borrow state precede gate unlock-release of PARKED. Collector lock-acquire checks all frozen members and zero active/layout debt."
